pr_body: This removes per-shell `sway_*_surface` and replaces them with `sway_*_view` which are more in line with the impl pattern. I believe this also fixes #1738.

issue_context.title: Tooltips from qutebrowser under wayland crash sway

review_comments: I think `pending_width|height` are already cached in wlroots. Can this be brought into the library?
Hum, this could be a good idea. This can be done in a separate PR though.
